verdict.rationale: Check's own docs cover both worker types in one API. They describe creating employees and running payrolls, and separately creating contractors with their payment information and methods. Check also produces both employee and contractor tax documents and surfaces payroll blockers for employees and contractors together. missing for 10: explicit naming of W-2 and 1099 forms, a documented single payroll run paying employees and contractors together, independent or hands-on corroboration.
